(schema)  version=1
    markdown: "Coralogix Api keys. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/api-keys/api-keys/."
access_policy  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "Api Key Access Policy. To clear an existing policy, explicitly set this to an empty string (\"\"). Omitting the attribute will preserve the existing policy."
    plan modifier: apikey.equivalentDocument Keeps the state value when the configured document is equal to it.
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
active  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Api Key Is Active."
hashed  BoolAttribute computed
    markdown: "Api Key Is Hashed."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "ApiKey ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Api Key name."
owner  SingleNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Api Key Owner. It can either be a team_id, organisation_id, or a user_id "
    plan modifier: objectplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    validator: apikey.oneOfArmsValidator At most one arm of each one-of group can be set, and exactly one when the group needs an arm.
owner.organisation_id  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Organisation identifier of the API key owner."
owner.team_id  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The team id."
owner.user_id  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "User identifier of the API key owner."
permissions  SetAttribute required elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Api Key Permissions"
presets  SetAttribute required elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Api Key Presets"
value  StringAttribute computed sensitive
    markdown: "The API key's secret value. The Coralogix API returns it for every key that is not hashed, so an imported key and a data source have it. A key that schema version 0 of the provider created as hashed has no value to read: Terraform keeps the one in its state."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
